$comment: DOCX export and import (feature 023): File > Export > Export as DOCX..., File > Import > DOCX File..., File > Open refusal, Save dialog & fallback options, Settings > Exports > DOCX, archive/FBD prompts, refusals, progress, and summaries.

exportDocx.description: Write the book as a standalone Microsoft Word (.docx) document with page layout, table of contents, footnotes or endnotes, and optional ZIP + FBD archive

importDocx.description: Make a new book from a standalone Microsoft Word (.docx) document or a ZIP archive holding one; the editor's own exports round-trip cleanly

docx.exportDone: Exported to {{path}}: {{sections}} sections, {{pictures}} pictures, {{tables}} tables, {{notes}} notes.
docx.exportCancelled: The DOCX export was cancelled; no file was written.
docx.exportSummaryIntro: Not everything was carried over as written:

exportSummary.repairedTitle: Filled in the exported file only: book title ({{detail}})
exportSummary.convertedPicture: Picture converted to JPEG or PNG: {{detail}}
exportSummary.duplicateId: Duplicate id made unique in the exported file: {{detail}}

writeFailed.targetIsSource: it is the book's own file, or the archive it was opened from.
writeFailed.badPageSize: the requested page size is not recognised.
writeFailed.badPart: a required part of the document could not be staged ({{detail}}).
writeFailed.checkFailed: the finished DOCX failed its own XML check ({{detail}}).
writeFailed.ioError: the file could not be written ({{detail}}).
writeFailed.unknownToken: the export session was no longer known to the core.

docx.openRefused: {{path}} is a Microsoft Word (.docx) document. File > Open takes FictionBook (FB2) books, FBD files and ZIP archives holding FB2 books or FBD packages; import a DOCX document with File > Import > DOCX File....
docx.openRefusedInArchive: {{path}} holds a Word (.docx) document but no FictionBook book. Import it with File > Import > DOCX File....
docx.importDone: Imported from DOCX: {{sections}} sections, {{pictures}} pictures, {{tables}} tables, {{notes}} notes.
docx.importCancelled: The DOCX import was cancelled; the book in the window is unchanged.
docx.importSummaryIntro: Not everything came over as written:

importSummary.fbdApplied: Book description loaded from companion FBD: {{detail}}
importSummary.externallyModified: The DOCX was modified outside the editor; your text and picture edits were kept along with the saved FB2 description.
importSummary.mfbeDamagedFallback: The editor's round-trip metadata could not be read; imported as a standard DOCX document.
importSummary.equationsAsText: Word equations converted to plain text: {{detail}}
importSummary.svgRasterized: Embedded SVG pictures converted to PNG/JPEG: {{detail}}
importSummary.droppedStyling: Custom Word fonts, colors, or borders omitted for clean FB2 output ({{detail}})
importSummary.droppedUnsupportedDrawings: Unsupported drawings, charts, or WMF/EMF graphics omitted: {{detail}}
importSummary.droppedHeadersFooters: Headers, footers, or page numbers omitted: {{detail}}
importSummary.droppedOleOrMedia: Embedded objects, audio, or video omitted: {{detail}}
importSummary.strayMacrosIgnored: Embedded macro data ignored and never executed: {{detail}}
importSummary.flattenedNestedTables: Nested tables flattened for FB2 compatibility: {{detail}}
importSummary.brokenInternalLink: Internal link target missing, kept as text: {{detail}}

refused.notDocx: it is not a valid Word (.docx) document.
refused.encrypted: password-protected or encrypted DOCX documents cannot be imported.
refused.legacyDoc: legacy Word 97–2003 (.doc) files are not supported; save the document as .docx first.
refused.macroEnabled: macro-enabled Word (.docm) files are not supported; save the document as standard .docx first.
refused.tooLarge: the file is larger than the editor allows for DOCX import.
refused.tooManyEntries: the archive contains too many entries.
refused.zipBomb: the unpacked document exceeds safe size or compression limits.
refused.damaged: the DOCX document is damaged or unreadable.
refused.empty: the DOCX document contains no importable text, tables, or images.
refused.fictionBook: it is already a FictionBook file; open it with File > Open.
refused.noDocxInArchive: the ZIP archive contains no DOCX document.
refused.archiveTooLarge: the ZIP archive exceeds safe size limits.
refused.archiveDamaged: the ZIP archive is damaged or unreadable.

archive.chooseBookTitle: Choose a DOCX document from the archive
archive.chooseBookPrompt: {{path}} holds more than one DOCX document. Choose which one to import:
archive.chooseFbdTitle: Use an FBD description from the archive?
archive.chooseFbdPrompt: Choose an FBD description from {{path}} to apply to the imported book, or keep the document's own metadata:
archive.fbdNone: Do not use an FBD (keep DOCX metadata)
archive.fbdConflictTitle: Archive FBD differs from DOCX description
archive.fbdConflictPrompt: {{fbd}} in the archive differs from the FB2 description stored inside the DOCX. Which description should be kept?

docx.pageSize: Default page size used when exporting a book to DOCX
docx.margins: Page margin preset (reuses PDF export proportions) or custom millimetres
docx.customMargin: Page margin width in millimetres (5 to 50 mm)
docx.fontFamily: Default body font family referenced by name in the DOCX without embedding font files
docx.customFontFamily: Custom font family name written into Word styles (falls back to Georgia if blank)
docx.textSizePt: Default body text size in points (10 to 14 pt)
docx.tocPlacement: Where to place the pre-populated clickable Table of contents in exported DOCX files
docx.notesPlacement: Whether referenced FB2 notes become Word footnotes at page bottom or endnotes at document end
docx.zip: Pack exported DOCX and companion FBD metadata into a single ZIP archive by default
docx.reset: Restore this option to its built-in default
docx.resetAll: Restore every DOCX export option to its built-in default
